programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: Andromeda: Himlarnas valvet

programme.title: Andromeda: Illusionen om majestät

programme.title: Andromeda: Idolernas skymning

programme.title: Andromeda: Domens dag, vredens dag

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sole Searching
programme.desc: Armed with little else, police hoped that shoe impressions found at a Lansing, Michigan crime scene would put their investigation of Audrey Nichols' murder back on track.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Murder on the Menu
programme.desc: When the head chef of a historic Philadelphia restaurant was found dead, investigators interviewed the usual suspects: family, friends and coworkers. As they sifted through the evidence, police uncovered a chilling tale of debt and deceit.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hot on the Trail
programme.desc: When Washington, DC is plagued by a series of arson fires — each started with the same type of incendiary device — it's up to forensic scientists to find the clues that lay in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: High 'n Dry
programme.desc: When Genell Plude is found dead in her bathroom, the scene points to suicide. But a coroner's inquest and a unique application of forensic science give investigators a different explanation for her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: To the Viktor
programme.desc: Faced with three homicides that appear to be professional executions, investigators on both sides of the Atlantic must find a common thread between the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wired for Disaster
programme.desc: Faced with three homicides that appear to be professional executions, investigators on both sides of the Atlantic must find a common thread between the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wood-be Killer
programme.desc: A killer tries to incinerate everything that could link him to his crime. But in doing so, he inadvertently creates new forensic evidence. Detectives employ a technique never before used in a criminal investigation to bring it to light.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Naughty or Nyce
programme.desc: A woman appears to have lost control of her SUV and plunged down an embankment into a shallow creek. But investigators suspect foul play when they find snowy footprints leading away from the crime scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Going for Broke
programme.desc: When a successful stockbroker doesn't return home after a late shift, his wife reports him missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Just Desserts
programme.desc: The prime suspect had a criminal record and his driver's license was found at the scene of a brutal double homicide.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sunday's Wake
programme.desc: When a little girl got sick and died, investigators were stumped. Was it an accident, an unexplained illness or murder?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shattered Dreams
programme.desc: When a car was found in a drainage ditch with two bodies inside, a fingertip torn from a latex glove would point investigators to both the crime scene and the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dockter Visit
programme.desc: An investigation into the murder of a World War II veteran slowed to a halt when the prime suspect had a solid alibi. But a lucky break led to a shady character who wore distinctive boots and had a sweet tooth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Murder, She Wrote
programme.desc: A woman who was known to have suffered from depression apparently took her own life. But her sister told police that, a year before her death, she said if anything were to happen to her there would be a note in the china cabinet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Concrete Alibi
programme.desc: An aspiring model turned up dead and the prime suspect was her boyfriend. When he was eventually cleared, investigators had to dig deeper to find the perpetrator. With the help of a forensic geologist, they identified the most unlikely suspects.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Key Evidence
programme.desc: When an off-duty policeman was shot dead, his fellow officers were determined to solve the crime. They needed clues to find the killer and they discovered them in tiny fibres and an asthma inhaler.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Gambler
programme.desc: One warm summer afternoon, the town of Verona, Wisconsin faced its first triple homicide. To solve the case, investigators had to delve into the world of high rollers and offshore betting.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Weakest Link
programme.desc: The body of a young girl was discovered on isolated farmland near Delano, California. She had no ID, but police found mailbox keys in the pocket of her jeans. With no other clues, they checked the mailboxes of every apartment building in Delano.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Capitol Crimes
programme.desc: The driver said he couldn't have hit and killed a pedestrian on a Harrisburg street. The Jeep Grand Cherokee he was leasing around that time had been sold months ago to a buyer in another state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Undertaken
programme.desc: The medical examiner ruled the death an accident, but the detectives investigating the case thought the evidence at the scene indicated otherwise.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dark Waters
programme.desc: When a hit-and-run boating accident caused the death of a popular young man, investigators faced the daunting task of searching for one boat among 1200 others.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nice Threads
programme.desc: A woman was found dead on the bedroom floor of her apartment. The crime scene yielded little of value and investigators wondered if they would find enough evidence to make a case, much less catch a killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Grave Danger
programme.desc: A young man was killed in a mysterious car crash, but the evidence at the scene led investigators to believe it was not an accident. Forensic science revealed what really happened and the truth devastated three families.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Internal Affair
programme.desc: When a woman went missing, friends and family were determined to find her. Their worst fears were confirmed weeks later when her body was discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Case of the Flue
programme.desc: In 1993, 82-year-old Kathryn Bishop was found dead in her Pennsylvania home. Tiny clues on the victim's body would tell police what happened that night.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Safe Place
programme.desc: A wealthy man and his wife were attacked by three masked men outside their luxurious Louisiana home. He was shot dead and she was forced to open their hidden safe. To solve the crime, police would have to find out who knew about the concealed safe.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Live Wire
programme.desc: A bomb, constructed to cause as much damage as possible, kills a victim with deadly force and flame. When a painstaking search yields some tiny clues, police are able to identify the killer as surely as if he'd signed them.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Van-ished
programme.desc: A twelve-year-old girl claimed she had been abducted and sexually assaulted. She recounted what happened in such a flat, unemotional voice that police found it difficult to believe her. Fibers on her clothing would prove she was telling the truth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Novel Idea
programme.desc: When the number and volume of bloodstains at the scene was greater than usual, it was up to forensic scientists to find out why.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Chief Suspect
programme.desc: The wife of a respected police officer was murdered in her own home. The crime went unsolved for more than a decade, until a newly formed cold case unit took a fresh look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Water Hazard
programme.desc: The victim had ingested a massive amount of cyanide. An unlikely clue ? a flaw on a mailing envelope ? exposed a murderer who was willing to kill innocent people.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shell Game
programme.desc: They thought the fire would cover their crime. But one tiny clue, no bigger than a thumbtack, remained. It held all the information investigators needed to put a trio of cold-blooded killers behind bars.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ring Him Up
programme.desc: In 1994, 19-year-old Shannon Melendi disappeared while at Emory University. Her disappearance remained a mystery for ten years, until new scientific testing cast a different light on Colvin "Butch" Hinton.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer Impression
programme.desc: In 1987, the death of Crystal Purcell was considered an accident. Then in 2001, Barbara Purcell called police to suggest that her estranged husband had killed Crystal.

programme.title: Forensic Files: If I Were You
programme.desc: Paul Gruber's daughter suspected something was wrong when she received birthday cards addressed from her father, but written in a stranger's handwriting.

programme.title: Forensic Files: As the Tide Turns
programme.desc: The woman was dead. The man had been shot four times and survived. When the man's version of events contradicted physical evidence, investigators turned to forensic science to paint a clearer picture of the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Tight Leash
programme.desc: How did the stalker obtain the security system code for his victim's home? How did he steal her personal photographs? Police needed answers and they found them in the most unlikely of places.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Muffled Cries
programme.desc: After inspecting storm damage to a home in Tampa, an insurance assessor simply disappeared. Thirty hours later, her body was found in a nearby river. But the killer had been careless.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Critical Maneuver
programme.desc: When a hit-and-run accident claimed the life of a high school athlete, everyone in town mourned his passing. Finding the killer was a long shot at best.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skirting the Evidence
programme.desc: A murder trail turned cold, until police got a call from a woman whose husband, Gerald Powers, had a criminal past and a fondness for Chevy Berettas.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.
programme.sub-title: The True Story of Mississippi Burning

programme.title: The New Detectives: True Crime
programme.desc: They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scattered Clues
programme.desc: There's never a good reason for murder, but some killers are particularly brutalchoosing their prey at random or with no apparent motive and then cunningly covering their tracks. Even so, telltale clues remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Abduction
programme.desc: Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Hidden Obsessions
programme.desc: In San Diego, California, a killer has left behind pieces of evidence. Detectives must sort through these small clues to prove murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written in Blood
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Bone
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Forsaken Trust
programme.desc: When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Loved To Death
programme.desc: A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Photography: Forensic photographers are among the first people at a crime scene, capturing vital clues on film. What do the cameras capture that can't be seen first-hand, and who are the men and women who analyze the camera's clues?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Killing Time
programme.desc: A killer may strike in the middle of the night, and hide clues well. But the police are always there, ready and working, and they will never give up when they're on the trail of criminals who decide it's Killing Time.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Wasted Youth
programme.desc: When teenagers are driven to kill, their victims are but the first to fall. In three such cases, the families of the killers, as well as their communities, become the victims of violent crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Unlikely Sources
programme.desc: Some of the best clues come from the least likely places. Baffling crimes have been solved and criminals betrayed through evidence provided by insects, beer bottles, and other seemingly meaningless objects.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Chemistry
programme.desc: The show examines cases of poison and deadly chemistry and shows how forensic experts are solving mysterious deaths today and from the past.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder By Numbers
programme.desc: For serial killers, once is never enough. For investigators, the challenge is steep when the killers murder by numbers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Short Fuse
programme.desc: Explosives Investigations: The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which was mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid, the box exploded, killing her instantly.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Seeds of Destruction

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder For Hire
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Sean and Bex head to one of Leeds’ oldest public libraries, where the silence hides more than just books. Reports of shadow figures, unexplained voices, and a terrifying presence in the basement have kept rumours alive for decades.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension

programme.title: Ghost Dimension

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Ex, Lies, and Polygraph Tape
programme.desc: Farrah återvänder för att ta reda på om hon kommit över sitt ex. Sanningen avslöjas när en lögndetektor tvingar alla i huset att ta en ärlig titt på sina relationer.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion Part 1
programme.desc: Efter en turbulent säsong återförenas singlarna och exen för första gången för att gå igenom säsongens strul, uppbrott och svek. Deltagarna avslöjar om de fortfarande är kära eller om de bestämde sig för att skita i kärleken.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion Part 2
programme.desc: Dramat fortsätter i del 2 av Ex on the Beach Reunion, då lögndetektorn tvingar Morgan att erkänna sanningen. Ett ej tidigare visat strul avslöjas, liksom otrohetsskandaler.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: War Of Words
programme.desc: Ex on the Beach är tillbaka med åtta singlar som hoppas finna kärlek på Bali - men istället finner Fatima och Nicole krig. Marty blir förtjust i Fatima och Che och Max dras genast till varandra - men hålller det när exen börjar komma?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: A Geordie Reunion
programme.desc: Jakten på kärlek fortsätter, men problem uppstår när Chloe från Geordie Shore avslöjar sina känslor för Marty. Jordan blir aggressiv mot alla, och fejden mellan Nicole och Fatima når ett dramatiskt klimax.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Clash Of The Titans
programme.desc: Ett vrålsnyggt ex anländer och skakar om villan. Jordan är ute efter Chloe, och när Marty söker tröst på annat håll uppstår ett Geordiebråk.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Max Makes His Move
programme.desc: Det hettar till i villan när Chloe får Marty att bli rasande. Kärleken mellan Max och Georgia får nytt liv, och Dean har planer för Che, men kan ett nytt ex hälla grus i maskineriet?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Action Speak Louder Than Words
programme.desc: Terrorpaddan fortsätter orsaka förödelse på stranden. Stevie får skicka hem en person, Chloe kräver Sams uppmärksamhet, och Brads nya romans tar honom till sjunde himlen.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Fight For Georgia
programme.desc: Kärlekens berg- och dalbana fortsätter för Chloe och Sam, med toppar och dalar. Max blir trött på Stevie och roar sig på annat håll, och när ett nytt ex anländer blir Georgia och Brad förvirrade.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Marty The Meddler
programme.desc: Klorna är ute när alla åker på safari och Dean känner sin status som alfahanne hotad. Marty lägger sig i Chloes och Sams förhållande och John har händerna fulla med Georgia.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Love Is In The Air
programme.desc: Terrorpaddan får fnatt och skickar Marty och Sam på en dejt. En nykomling får tvillingarna att strida medan Georgia och Johns förhållande bara blir starkare.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: #Ballininbalifinale
programme.desc: Strandpartyt på Bali får ett dramatiskt slut när den sista ankomsten skapar kaos i villan. Georgia och John faller vid sista hindret, och Chloe får till slut lite action från Sam.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Welcome to the Peak
programme.desc: 10 dokusåpakändisar kommer till ett vinterparadis för att se om de kan hitta någon ny att vintermysa med. Vad de inte vet är att deras ex kommer att dra in som en lavin.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Winter Un-Wonderland
programme.desc: Callums och Nicoles ex orsakar stora problem i fjällstugan. Ett par får snabbt kontakt och ett annat förlorar kontakten. Ett nytt ex dyker upp och första heta dejten delas ut.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Caught Red Velvet Handed
programme.desc: Daniel gör ett trevande försök att få kontakt. Värmen stiger i bastun för en singel som kör dubbelt. Första exet åker ut ur fjällstugan.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Boo Years Eve!
programme.desc: Marlons ex blir varse en hemlighet. Två singlar blir konkurrenter om samma ex. Det hettar till på isceremonin när ett ex gör ett oväntat drag.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1978 Cadillac Sedan DeVille
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar gänget Niles Cadillac Sedan DeVille. Nile rullar hem i en pärlemorlackad ceriserosa bil med bagageluckan full av nya skor.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1986 Oldsmobile Cutlass Supreme
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet Logans Oldsmobile Cutlass Supreme. Logan rullar hem med basketgolv och lack i två färger.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1992 Honda Civic
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet Christines Honda Civic. Tre dagar efter att avsnittet med Christine sändes dog en nära släkting i magcancer.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1990 Mitsubishi Mirage
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet från West Coast Customs Antwons Mitsubishi Mirage. Antwon rullar hem på 18-tumsdäck och med ett akvarium i baksätet.

programme.title: 1967 Ford Mustang
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar West Coast Customs Marys Ford Mustang. Hennes bil utrustas med den allra senaste teknikens platt-tv.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1985 Ford Ranger
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet från West Coast Customs Jareds Ford Ranger. Jared rullar iväg tre tum lägre med pärlemorlack i orange.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Pontiac Trans Am
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar West Coast Customs Danelles Pontiac Trans Am. Hon rullar iväg i en bil utrustad med kaffebryggare och kristallkrona.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar gänget från West Coast Customs Neils Chevrolet LUV Truck. Han rullar därifrån i ett campingtält på hjul.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1989 Ford Mustang
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar gänget från West Coast Customs Shondas Ford Mustang Convertible. Hon rullar iväg i ett pimpat och helt trafiksäkert fordon.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Maxima Station Wagon
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet från West Coast Customs Ezras Nissan Maxima Station Wagon. Han rullar iväg i ett mobilt DJ-bås.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Volkswagen Baja
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet från West Coast Customs Krissys Volkswagen Baja Bug. Bubblan från 1969 konstruerades med hållbarhet som mål. Men med sitt böjda avgasrör och sina trasiga dörrar kan den verkligen beskrivas som allt annat än just det.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1987 Honda CRX
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet från West Coast Customs Brians Honda CRX. Det är den första bilen som får en splitterny motor, eftersom den gamla dör innan Xzibit får in den på verkstaden.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: '72 Landcruiser
programme.desc: Gaby var en nyligen dumpad yogainstruktör, som inte hade något i världen utom sin yogamatta och sin Land Cruiser från 1972. Expojkvännen sålde bilen till henne för 200 dollar. Killarna börjar jobba med utsidan...

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1989 Ford Escort
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar gänget från West Coast Customs Kerrys Ford Escort. Bilen hade svetsats och "klistrats" ihop av två separata bilar. Gänget bedömde att den var trafikfarlig...

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1984 Cadillac Eldorado
programme.desc: Xzibit takes a beat-up 1984 Cadillac Eldorado and restores it to it's former glory.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1991 Ford Escort
programme.desc: In this episode, Xzibit and the boys at West Coast Customs transform a '91 Ford Escort into a European luxury mobile.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1958 VW Bus
programme.desc: In this episode, Xzibit and West Coast Customs give a 1958 VW some California love, and turn it into the ultimate beach ride.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1985 Suburban
programme.desc: In this episode, Xzibit takes a busted off-road '85 Suburban and gives it an electronic makeover not to be believed.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1987 Chevrolet Blazer
programme.desc: In this episode, Xzibit puts the fire back into a wrecked '87 Chevy Blazer.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1988 Acura Legend
programme.desc: In this episode, Xzibit and West Coast Customs help a 1988 Acura Legend live up to its name.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 2005 Toyota 4Runner
programme.desc: When Xzibit rolls on into the garage with the Fairlane, the boys can't believe their eyes. So they decide to give West his Fairlane back to tinker with and get him a brand-new pimped Toyota 4Runner.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1985 Ford Econoline Van
programme.desc: Xzibit and the boys at West Coast pimp Nate's Ford Econoline.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1998 Mitsubishi Eclipse

programme.desc: Xzibit and the boys at West Coast get an unforgettable surprise when they discover a previous tenant living inside a neglected 1976 Pacer.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 2003 Corolla

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1986 Chevy Pickup
programme.desc: In this episode, West Coast Customs pimps Heather's Chevrolet C10.

programme.desc: In this episode, West Coast Customs pimps Jake's Buick Century.

programme.desc: In this episode, West Coast Customs pimps Cristi's Chevrolet Panel Truck.

programme.desc: In this episode, the crew pimps Calvin's Chevrolet Malibu.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Galant

programme.title: Are You The One?: Flirt at Your Own Risk
programme.desc: Zak får känna på Brias vrede när han flörtar med andra kvinnor och hela huset dras med i dramatiken. Tevins och Kenyas raggningsvanor hotar deras spirande romans.

programme.title: Are You The One?: With Frenemies Like These...
programme.desc: Zak utforskar sina valmöjligheter medan kvinnorna slåss om honom. Kenya och Jasmine blir officiellt fiender.

programme.title: Are You The One?: A Boyfriend by Any Other Name
programme.desc: Asia blir sårad när hon får veta vad hennes vän och hennes flört har gjort. Romansen mellan Kali och Brett äventyras av deras dåliga dejtingvanor.
programme.sub-title: A Boyfriend by Any Other Name

programme.title: Are You The One?: Ex-tracurricular Activities
programme.desc: Huset skakas om när deras ex hälsar på. Det blir spänt när ex hotar att splittra ett starkt par, och en annan blir aggressiv. Zak slits mellan Bria och Morgan.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Spilling The Tea
programme.desc: Kwasi orsakar tumult när han avslöjar vad Tevin och Jasmine gjorde igår kväll. Bria blir arg på relationen mellan Morgan och Zak, och deltagarna tar en risk när de ska välja partner.

programme.title: Are You The One?: He Loves Me Not
programme.desc: Cam ifrågasätter sin relation med Kayla, Daniels skojeri driver bort Sam, och huset står inför det hittills viktigaste Sanningsbåset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Beast Mode
programme.desc: Spänningar uppstår mellan Cam och Kwasi när Kwasi stöter på Kayla. Asia får ett utbrott när hon tror att vissa personer i huset är skumma. Zak måste göra ett val.

programme.title: Are You The One?: I Want You To Want Me
programme.desc: Nutsa är tänd på Brett, och Bretts oförmåga att glömma Cali får följder för hela huset. Moe pressas att börja spela spelet. Lewis avslöjar sina känslor för Asia.
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Want Me

programme.title: Are You The One?: Master Plan
programme.desc: Brias besatthet av Zak och Zaks player-attityd hotar husets förmåga att spela spelet. Cali kommer på en plan för hur man ska klura ut vilka av paren som är bekräftade par och vilka som inte är det.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Once Upon a Crazy Party Time
programme.desc: På en vild fest gör tvivelaktigt beteende bästa vänner till ovänner. Tevin och Kenya gör sig redo att möta sitt öde. Moe pressas att prestera bättre.
programme.sub-title: Once Upon a Crazy Party Time

programme.title: Are You The One?: Caught On Kiss Cam
programme.desc: Kwasi och Jasmines relation äventyras när en bekant fiende lägger sig i. Starka par försöker knyta nya kontakter.

programme.title: Are You The One?: This is Nuts-a
programme.desc: Brett hamnar i heta stolen när han tvivlar på sina känslor för Nutsa. Det är krisläge i huset när alla försöker hitta bekräftade par.

programme.title: Are You The One?: It All Comes Down To This
programme.desc: Asia försöker sabotera Sams relation med Daniel. Huset får en sista chans att vinna kärlek och pengar, och en extra dag för att hantera resultatet.
programme.sub-title: It All Comes Down To This

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion The Final Matchup
programme.desc: Efter veckor av jakt på kärlek och spel om pengar återförenas deltagarna i säsong 7 för att skvallra om alla dramatiska händelser och berätta vad som hänt sen de lämnade huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Come One, Come All Part 1
programme.desc: För första gången nånsin har kärleken inga gränser och alla är en möjlighet när 16 singlar anländer till Hawaii för en chans att vinna 1 000 000 dollar.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: De starkaste paren har redan fått problem i paradiset. Ett par kämpar med tanken på ett öppet förhållande och kärlekstrianglar konfigureras om.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Justin sitter i kläm emellan en som vill ha honom och en som inte vet vad hen vill. Basit kämpar för att bli accepterad och huset ställs inför några obehagliga sanningar.

programme.title: Are You The One?: We Come to Slay
programme.desc: Efter queer-balen är hela huset upp och ner, både bildligt och bokstavligt. Dramatiska strul dödsdömer två par. Dionne Slay anländer.

programme.title: Are You The One?: There Was A Fivesome?
programme.desc: En femkant skakar om gruppdynamiken. Justins självdestruktivitet hotar hans relation med Max. Danny skapar kontakt.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Hate to Burst Your Bubble
programme.desc: Alla är fast beslutna att ta reda på vilket par som matchar. Jonathan vill spräcka en kärleksbubbla, och Kai går vidare mitt framför Jenna.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Red Flag Alert
programme.desc: Jonathan försöker försonas med Basit. Ett par kommer varandra närmare, medan ett annat kämpar med förgiftande dejtingbeteende.

programme.title: What Maisie Knew
programme.desc: Wallace har precis blivit bedragen av sitt livs kärlek när han träffar Chantry. När Chantrys pojkvän Ben tvingas flytta i jobbet kommer Wallace och Chantry närmare varandra och Wallace överväger att berätta för Chantry hur han verkligen känner.

programme.title: A Midsummer's Hawaiian Dream
programme.desc: I denna parafras på Shakespeares “En midsommarnattsdröm” försöker två gifta antropologprofessorer och deras studenter hitta en helig tiki för att stoppa skövlingen av Hawaiis djungel.

programme.title: The Cat's Meow
programme.desc: År 1924 samlade mediamogulen William Randolph Hearst några av världens mest kända personer på sin yacht – en kväll som resulterade i ett ännu olöst, nedtonat mord.

programme.title: Tully
programme.desc: En ny dramakomedi från teamet bakom Juno med Charlize Theron i huvudrollen som Marlo.

programme.title: What If
programme.desc: I en inte alls avlägsen framtid överlistar sju identiska systrar den ettbarnspolitik som råder genom att turas om att anta identiteten av en person. De lämnar lägenheten en dag var, tills den dag då en av systrarna inte kommer hem.

programme.title: How to Be
programme.desc: Art (Robert Pattinson) blir dumpad av flickvännen och flyttar tillbaka hem till mamma och pappa och hamnar i en 25-årskris. Art lägger sitt arv på inköp och new age-terapi och tar så småningom även hjälp av en excentrisk själv-hjälps-guru, Dr Ellington.

programme.title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
programme.desc: Gilbert Grape bor i den amerikanska småstadshålan Endora tillsammans med sin familj. Han tyngs av vetskapen att han aldrig lär komma från hems, men en dag kommer strandsatta Becky till staden, och hon får Gilbert att tänka på ett och annat.

programme.title: The Shamrock Spitfire
programme.desc: Den sanna historien om den irländske jaktpiloten Brendan "Paddy" Finucane som blott 21 år gammal blev den yngste divisionschefen någonsin i Royal Air Force och en av det brittiska flygvapnets främsta och mest hyllade flygaräss under andra världskriget.

programme.title: Carmen & Lola
programme.desc: Sjuttonåriga Carmen är redan förlovad. Hon förväntas snart gifta sig, få många barn och leva som hennes stora romska släkt alltid har gjort i Madrids förorter. Men när Carmen träffar sin fästmans kusin, den sextonåriga Lola, förändras allt.

programme.title: Flesh and Bone
programme.desc: En man och en kvinna träffas och inleder en romans, utan att veta att de delar en hemsk hemlighet från sitt förflutna.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Puerto Rico, a band of extremists waged a guerrilla war against the United States. Their goal, to make the island an independent nation, or die trying.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Women are most often assaulted by someone they know. Near Las Vegas in December of 2000 a young woman became the latest victim of a violent sex offender. Before authorities could locate him, he would add murder to his list of crimes.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the early 1990's Philadelphia became the scene of a bloody vendetta. The streets erupted in mob warfare. Authorities feared innocent people would be caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Family Torn
programme.desc: The parents of 11 yr. old Brittany Martinez knew their daughter was no runaway. Something had happened to her, something terrible. When they failed to find Brittany in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 70s and early 80s, a legitimate Puerto Rican independence movement took hold in the United States. But a splinter terrorist group known as the FALN was suspected of executing hundreds of bombings in major US cities.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Trail
programme.desc: The disappearance of young women triggered a search that spanned the Pacific Northwest. A massive media campaign failed to locate the drifter, who first charmed then killed them. As investigators followed his trail, he always stayed one step ahead.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 1990s, one criminal terrorized an entire community. Witnesses refused to speak out. They knew the consequences could be deadly.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the southwest one serial bank robber claimed his loot went to the poor, but this thief was no folk hero. He had a gun and was willing to shoot.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When the streets of New York flooded with crack cocaine in the 1980's a wave of violence threatened to drown the city. Colombian cartels brought the coke in and ran their operations with an iron fist.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Killing Zone
programme.desc: In the 1990's the war on drugs was in full swing. The front lines were often America's inner cities where gangs use violence and murder to rule their empires.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brotherhood of Hate
programme.desc: In 1984, a tragic murder led agents into the frightening world of domestic terrorism. Law enforcement vowed to dismantle the violent faction that claimed responsibility.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover
programme.desc: Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: Asteroid: Final Impact
programme.desc: Astrofysikern Steve Thomas upptäcker att en dödlig asteroid är på kollisionskurs med jorden. Ingen tror honom så han måste själv se till att rädda mänskligheten.

programme.title: In the Name of Ben-Hur
programme.desc: A young gladiator enslaved in the Roman arena in 171 A.D. escapes by chariot towards the freedom of Hadrian's Wall. Fighting centurions and mercenaries along the way, he becomes a folk hero for all those struggling to fight Roman oppression.

programme.title: L.A. Gigolo
programme.desc: en unga och charmerande Nicki (Ashton Kutcher) lever ett liv som enbart de snyggaste kan drömma om. Han svindlar till sig en luxuös livsstil genom att tillfredställa rika kvinnor i sängen – och han är djävulskt bra på det!

programme.title: The Good Heart
programme.desc: Jaques (Brian Cox – THE BOURNE IDENTITY) äger en sjaskig bar, som fungerar som ett andra hem för en brokig skara professionella drinkare. Jaques själv är fast besluten att supa och röka sig till döds. När han möter den unge hemlöse Lucas…

programme.title: Brad's Status
programme.desc: Under en resa börjar Brad fundera på ungdomsvännernas rika och glamorösa tillvaro. Hans bekväma och trevliga medelklassliv bleknar i jämförelse. Besvikelsen tar överhanden och han börjar ifrågasätta hur bra hans liv egentligen är.

programme.title: What If
programme.desc: I en inte alls avlägsen framtid överlistar sju identiska systrar den ettbarnspolitik som råder genom att turas om att anta identiteten av en person. De lämnar lägenheten en dag var, tills den dag då en av systrarna inte kommer hem.

programme.title: Dating Amber
programme.desc: Tonåringarna Eddie och Amber växer upp i en irländsk småstad under 1990-talet. Alla misstänker att de är gay och varje dag är en kamp. De blir ihop på låtsas och inser att en påhittad relation kan vara minst lika komplicerad som en äkta.

programme.title: A Merry Holiday
programme.desc: Christy, en mycket framgångsrik försäljare stressar över att landa en stor affär. Till sin hjälp måste hon samarbeta med Jonathan som är fullt upptagen med att skapa en magisk jul till sin flickvän. Konflikten är given, men något annat börjar också gry...

programme.title: Chloe & Theo
programme.desc: Chloe, en ung kvinna som lever på gatan i New York, möter den vise inuiten Theo, som har skickats till New York av sina ”äldste” för att överlämna ett budskap till världen.

programme.title: Den fantastiske räven
programme.desc: Den hyllade regissören Wes Anderson är tillbakamed en stilren filmatisering av R. Dahls historiaom den ädle och charmige räven som användersin slughet för att överlista de elaka bröderna.

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Reese Witherspoon spelar Tracy Flick, en toppelev, fast besluten att bli ordförande för Carver Highs elevråd. Den populäre läraren Jim McAllister (Broderick) bestämmer sig för att stoppa Tracy och rekryterar en oppositionskandidat.

programme.title: The Bad News Bears
programme.desc: Ett gäng klumpiga, basebollspelande juniorer med en en elvaårig tjej som fuskande kastare, tränas av en komisk, ölpimplande, för detta medioker basebollspelare, som leder dem till mästerskap.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Disappeared Of Nancy: The Julie Martin Affair
programme.desc: On June 30, 2014, in Nancy, the police are called to the home of Julie Martin, a 34-year-old nurse.
programme.sub-title: The Disappeared Of Nancy: The Julie Martin Affair

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Raphael Lomoro Case
programme.desc: On June 12th 2007, in Berhen-lès-Forbach, in Moselle, a young woman reports the disappearance of her brother Raphaël Lomoro, 46 years old vanilla producer living in Madagascar.

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Fraud Squad.S01E07.Employment Scam & Adoption Fraud
programme.desc: A college student trying to earn some extra cash and finds himself involved in a job where instead of making money, he loses it due to a fraudulent cheque

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Vampire Diaries
programme.desc: In a picture-perfect East Coast town, an 80-year-old widow is viciously murdered in a gruesome ritual killing, and the evidence indicates the killer cut out her heart and drank her blood.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: Three Bizarre Cases of Alien Abductions
programme.desc: Ryan and Shane examine three compelling cases of alien abduction and the mysteries of the universe.
programme.sub-title: Three Bizarre Cases of Alien Abductions

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case)
programme.desc: On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. She made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept.
programme.sub-title: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case)

programme.title: Under Arrest: I'm Going to Sue
programme.desc: A drunk suspect battles with police, a cyclist is fatally hit by a bus and undercover police stake out a stolen vehicle.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Faith Healer
programme.desc: A trucker at a roadside rest station discovers the fully clothed body of a dead East Indian woman.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: When an infant's body washes up on the shores of Deer Island, Massachusetts, residents rally to find out who she is, and what happened to her. Their unprecedented solidarity gets nationwide attention.

programme.title: Women Behind Bars
programme.desc: Donna claims that it was self-defense when she stabbed her boyfriend, Charles, 54 times. Next, 2-year-old Serinity died from injuries consistent with child abuse.

programme.title: Miami Water Cops
programme.desc: This week, the cops rush out to a burning boat and the sheriff gets himself in a 60mile/hour boat chase.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: Keith Douglas is met with a barrage of bullets as he opens his door. The police are looking to Dr. G for hard evidence to link certain suspects to the murder.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Episode 8
programme.desc: Two men who kill a gun shop owner and steal a cache of handguns begin a crime spree that terrorizes a city. How will science turn the weapons back on the killers?

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: When a woman is found brutally murdered in her workplace, a long list of suspects and a lack of DNA evidence means prosecutors must persuade a jury to send a man to prison based on circumstantial evidence alone.

programme.title: Unsolved Murders
programme.desc: Ghislaine Marchal was found lifeless in her villa in Cannes, next to her, a message written on a door: "Omar killed me".

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: When the husband, Tao Chen, is shot to death by his wife Jun, she claims she pulled the trigger in self-defense when a drunken Tao came after her with a gun.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: A diabetic man dies after a night out. Meanwhile, an elderly man's decomposing body is found in his son’s home. Dr. G realizes that finding the causes of death will be anything but straightforward.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: To give her daughter a better chance of making the high school cheerleading squad, Wanda Holloway conspired to kill another cheerleader and her mother. The case shocked the nation.

programme.title: Under Arrest: Driving on Three Wheels
programme.desc: A high-speed chase of a stolen sports car takes place, police attend a violent domestic dispute and a suspect arrested with a sex trade worker accuses police of racism.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: In December 1986, a young college student was found murdered off a remote highway overpass in San Diego. The thought of a killer roaming the freeways of Southern California's sun-drenched urban paradise had female drivers in the area wrought with fear.

programme.title: South Park: Kycklingälskaren
programme.desc: När Barbrady anlitar pojkarna för att hjälpa till att lösa fallet med den ökända kycklingälskaren blir Cartman lite väl upptänd av sin nyfunna auktoritet.

programme.title: South Park: Douche eller bajsmacka?
programme.desc: När PETA förstör South Parks maskot splittrar diskussionen om en ersättning skolan. Stan hotas av P Diddy och förvisas från stan för att han vägrar rösta.

programme.title: South Park: Den ostoppbare
programme.desc: Den för evigt oskyldige Butters är trött på hur han behandlas av sina föräldrar och anammar den nya vampyrfebern lite väl entusiastiskt.

programme.title: South Park: South Park är gay!
programme.desc: Tack vare 'Queer Eye for the Straight Guy' har hela South Park blivit metrosexuellt.

programme.title: South Park: Pajama Day
programme.desc: Fjärdeklassarna förbjuds att bära pyjamas i skolan på årets viktigaste dag.

programme.title: South Park: Skoterdags
programme.desc: Barnen planerar att använda det senaste inom mobilitet för att få mer godis på Halloween än nånsin tidigare.

programme.title: South Park: South Parks fantastiska påskspecial
programme.desc: Stan bestämmer sig för att ta reda på anledningen bakom målade påskägg och upptäcker en hemlighet om den katolska kyrkan.

programme.title: South Park: Timmy 2000
programme.desc: Pojkarna härmar Timmy, som har ADD, för att slippa göra sina läxor.

programme.title: South Park: Helgspecial
programme.desc: En vit man och en infödd amerikan skapar ett band som inte går att förneka.

programme.title: South Park: De levande hemlösas natt
programme.desc: När South Park översvämmas av hemlösa människor tänker pojkarna ut en listig plan för att flytta dem till en annan stad medan de vuxna får panik.

programme.title: South Park: Lössningen
programme.desc: Cartman tar sig an uppgiften att ta reda på från vem alla lössen i South Park Elementary kommer ifrån så att han kan reta honom.

programme.title: South Park: Cartmans morsa är en slampa
programme.desc: Dr Mephisto hjälper Cartman att gräva fram sanningen om hans pappas identitet. Strålkastarljuset skiner på ett antal invånare i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Musikalen Helen Keller!
programme.desc: Pojkarna skapar en egen version av berättelsen om Helen Keller för att överglänsa dagisets uppsättning.

programme.title: South Park: Kinaproblemet
programme.desc: Cartman blir förskräck när han ser hur storslagen OS-invigningen är. Han anlitar Butters för att hjälpa honom att konfrontera kineserna. Samtidigt bevittnar Stan och Kyle Indiana Jones 'våldtäkt'.

programme.title: South Park: Den mexikanske jokern
programme.desc: Randy kämpar mot majja och Kyle åker på läger.

programme.title: South Park: Starvin' Marvin in Space
programme.desc: Marvin är tillbaka! Han och pojkarna reser världen runt för att samla in mat medan de förföljs hack i häl av CIA och Sally Struthers.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasilandet III
programme.desc: Stan och Butters är fast i Imaginationland och måste slåss för sina liv mot en ondskefull armé. Kyle och Cartman är fortfarande i Pentagon.

programme.title: South Park: Världens största blockflöjtskonsert
programme.desc: Klassen besöker Mr Garrisons hemstad i Arkansas för att gå på en konsert där de försöker hitta det mystiska "bruna ljudet".

programme.title: South Park: Margaritaville
programme.desc: Randy har en lösning på hur man ska lösa den ekonomiska krisen.

programme.title: South Park: Krymplingslagsmål!
programme.desc: Big Gay Al återvänder till South Park men blir av med sin roll som scoutledare för att han är gay.

programme.title: South Park: Förlåt, Jesse Jackson
programme.desc: Randy gör bort sig fatalt när han använder 'n-ordet' i direktsändning på TV. Cartman kan inte motstå att reta en dvärg som kommer till skolan för att lära barnen om fördomar.

programme.title: South Park: Korkad, bortskämd hora-leksaken
programme.desc: Paris Hilton öppnar en butik i South Park och fördärvar samtidigt flickornas moral. Endast Wendy håller fast vid gamla normer.

programme.title: South Park: Små brottsförebyggare
programme.desc: Pojkarna skapar en kriminalklubb för att lösa lokala brott och de lyckas hitta en försvunnen docka.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpoko Mon
programme.desc: Stan, Cartman och Kenny är fast i den senaste trenden från Japan, en tecknad serie som heter Chinpokomon - men vad är den hemliga planen bakom programmets antiamerikanska motiv?

programme.title: South Park: Den magiska busken
programme.desc: Cartman och Butters får tag på en drönare och tar en flygtur i kvarteret.

programme.title: South Park: Hooden invaderar
programme.desc: Eftersom Token känner sig utanför som det enda rika barnet i stan försöker han locka fler rika människor till South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Du Yelper inte
programme.desc: Cartman anser sig vara South Parks viktigaste matkritiker på nätet.

programme.title: South Park: Röd släde nedskjuten
programme.desc: Cartman tar jultomten, Mr. Hankey och Jesus till hjälp för att försöka skänka julkänsla till de förtryckta massorna i Irak - allt för att hamna på tomtens lista över snälla barn.

programme.title: South Park: Dansar med smurfar
programme.desc: Cartman blir utnämnd till att läsa upp morgonnyheterna i högtalarna på South Park Elementary.

programme.title: South Park: Endast medlemmar
programme.desc: Den tillträdande presidenten besöker sin hemstad.

programme.title: South Park: Läskiga fisken

programme.title: iCarly: Jag ställer inte in showen
programme.desc: Efter att Sam plötsligt åkt i fängelse, lovar Carly och Freddie dyrt och heligt att inte ställa in webbshowen eftersom hennes pappa ska titta på den. Så Carly ber Spencer hjälpa till, vilket visar sig bli svårt eftersom han har en dejt samma kväll.

programme.title: iCarly: Ute i rymden

programme.title: iCarly: Bröllopsbesvär

programme.title: iCarly: Tröjor till salu

programme.title: iCarly: Jag är på bushumör
programme.desc: När hon blir hånad för att hon aldrig har hittat på något busigt skämt, rekryterar Carly Spencer för att skoja med Sam och Freddie. Men när Spencer får smak på det, kan han inte sluta skämta. Gänget måste komma på ett sätt att få stopp på honom.

programme.title: iCarly: Sams mamma
